label: early-copy step (recalling orig 3-4) in long sequences, boosted by fed-back z/s/o/c
explanation: Low-magnitude unit that fires only in the copy phase. It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on the first two outputs. Activation is concentrated at recall_idx 3-4 (89% of the mass), i.e. when the fed-back input is orig(2) or orig(3) and 4-5 outputs are still left. It needs long sequences: none for L<=5, and mass grows with L (60% at L=9). Within that window, the fed-back token is the main thing setting magnitude: z gives by far the largest activations (all of the top examples are z or s fed back at recall_idx 3), followed by s, o and c, with digits slightly elevated. Position alone gets mass recall 0.89 but precision only 0.11. Adding the z/s/o/c token set raises dev F1 to about 0.42 (P 0.41, R 0.43, mass 0.54). Many z/s/o/c steps at the right position stay silent, so some other context-dependent factor we did not capture also gates it.
